recipe_version.title: Peruvian Tacu Tacu with a Pan-Fried Egg and Salsa Criolla
recipe_version.description: A crisp-crusted cake of rice and canary beans seasoned with onion, garlic, and ají amarillo, pan-fried until golden, topped with a runny pan-fried egg and a tangy salsa criolla of red onion, ají, and lime.

ingredients.name: red onions
ingredients.note: 1 for the cakes, 1 for the salsa

ingredients.name: ají amarillo paste
ingredients.display_name: ají amarillo paste whose label lists only peppers, salt, and acid

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp rice, 1 tsp cakes, 1/2 tsp salsa

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp aromatics, the rest for the cakes and eggs

steps.title: Rinse the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the rinse runs nearly clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: While the rice cooks, finely chop one onion for the cakes and slice the other into thin half-moons for the salsa. Mince the garlic, chop the cilantro, and juice the limes. Drain the beans, reserving 1/4 cup of their liquid. (overlap stated)

steps.title: Cool the rice
steps.body: Spread the hot rice on a rimmed sheet pan to cool and steam off, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the salsa criolla
steps.body: While the rice cools, toss the sliced onion with the lime juice, 1 tbsp ají paste, 1/2 tsp salt, and half the cilantro (overlap stated).

steps.title: Season the bean base
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium. Cook the chopped onion until soft, about 5 minutes; add the garlic, 2 tbsp ají paste, and oregano for 1 minute. Add the beans and their reserved liquid and 1 tsp salt and mash coarsely, about 2 minutes. Scrape into a bowl, fold in the rice, and shape into 4 thick oval cakes. Wipe the skillet.

steps.title: Pan-fry the cakes
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium-high. Pan-fry 2 cakes at a time until deep golden and crisp, about 4 minutes per side, adding oil as needed. Keep warm on plates.

steps.title: Pan-fry the eggs
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium, add a little oil, and pan-fry the eggs until the whites set and the yolks stay runny, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Top each cake with an egg and a heap of salsa criolla, and scatter the remaining cilantro.
